title: 第23章 我闭关的时候你们就是在数灵石第24章 下山走着
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
丹顶峰，李玄的府邸内，回荡着阵阵兴奋的声音。
“这是你的那份灵石，你们两个每人三成利润。”
“目前他们只是嘴上喊着有副作用，讨伐什么的而已。”
“实际上醒脉丹的效果摆在这里，估计以后还会偷偷购买。”
冷月涵抱着储物袋，眼里闪烁着精芒。
“哎呀，怎么会有这么多的灵石，赚麻了。”
上官柔儿盯着手中的储物袋也是神色复杂。
原来当心足够黑的时候，能够在短时间内挣到这么多的灵石。
突然感觉良心这个东西也是没有啥用的。
“多谢师弟相助，这些灵石估计都够我修行到筑基境界了。”
“不过估计最近灵兽峰是回不去了。”
先前于灵兽峰内宣传醒脉丹。
如今灵兽峰李玄已经成为人人喊打的名字。
两人早就被绑定在一起。
上官柔儿若是回去灵兽峰的话。
即便同门弟子对她尚有尊敬，可不怕一万就怕万一啊。
李玄摆手安慰道。
“你失去的知识来自同门师弟师妹的敬重，可你得到的是数不尽的财富。”
“你品……你细品。”
此话一出，上官柔儿顿时感觉好受不少。

“师弟当真是炼丹奇才，以后若是得到丹方，直接来找师弟便是了。”
李玄乐呵呵的轻声道。
“都是师父教得好，我还得修行，这里也有客房，两位师姐请便。”
都是一条船上的蚂蚱，几人的关系自然亲近几分。
冷月涵对这里熟悉无比，拉着上官柔儿就去客房数灵石了。
主房中的李玄取出灵石，整个房间内灵气充裕，都要化作浓雾液体。
售卖金刚丹和醒脉丹收益的大头都在他这里。
储物袋中的灵石可谓是堆积如山，实在是财大气粗。
再加上先前刻苦炼制丹药，对原本的修为瓶颈有所影响。
如今自当一鼓作气冲击炼气五层。
炽热的气息将无尽的灵气都凝聚一点。
好似涓涓细流般的灵气不断融入李玄的体内。
瓶颈已经开始松动，迸发出阵阵破碎的声音。
content_en:
At the top of Dan Peak, Li Xuan's mansion echoed with excited sounds.
"This is your share of the spiritual stone. Each of you two will make 30% of the profit."
"Currently they are just claiming that it has side effects and crusade."
"Actually, the effect of the Awakening Pulse Pill is here. I guess I will buy it secretly in the future."
Leng Yuehan hugged the storage bag, her eyes sparkling.
"Oh, how come there are so many spiritual stones? It's so hard to make money."
Shangguan Rouer stared at the storage bag in her hand with a complicated expression.
It turns out that if you are careful enough, you can earn so many spiritual stones in a short period of time.
Suddenly I feel that conscience is of no use.
"Thank you for your help, junior brother. These spiritual stones are probably enough for me to practice to the foundation-building realm."
"But I guess I won't be able to go back to Spirit Beast Peak recently."
Previously, the Awakening Pulse Pill was promoted in Spirit Beast Peak.
Nowadays, Li Xuan of Spirit Beast Peak has become a name that everyone shouts about.
The two have long been bound together.
If Shangguan Rouer goes back to Spirit Beast Peak.
Even if her fellow disciples still respect her, they are not afraid of ten thousand, just in case.
Li Xuan waved his hand to comfort him.
"The knowledge you lost came from the respect of your fellow junior brothers and sisters, but what you gained was countless wealth."
"Taste it... taste it carefully."
As soon as these words came out, Shangguan Rouer suddenly felt much better.
"Junior brother is really a genius in alchemy. If you get the pill recipe in the future, just come to him directly."
Li Xuan said softly happily.
"Master taught me well. I still have to practice. There are also guest rooms here. Please help me, two senior sisters."
We are all grasshoppers on the same boat, so the relationship between them is naturally quite close.
Leng Yuehan was very familiar with this place, so she took Shangguan Rouer and went to the guest room to count the spiritual stones.
Li Xuan in the main room took out the spiritual stone, and the entire room was filled with spiritual energy, which turned into a thick mist liquid.
He earns most of the revenue from selling Diamond Pills and Awakening Pulse Pills.
The spiritual stones in the storage bag can be said to be piled up like a mountain, which is really a wealth.
Coupled with the previous hard work refining the elixir, it had an impact on the original bottleneck of cultivation.
Now I should attack the fifth level of Qi refining in one go.
The fiery breath condenses the endless spiritual energy.
A trickle of spiritual energy continued to flow into Li Xuan's body.
The bottleneck has begun to loosen, bursting out with bursts of breaking sounds.
